prompts.clouds: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent atmospheric texture atlas with FOUR distinct wide horizontal cold storm-cloud banks in an evenly spaced 2 by 2 grid. True transparent alpha background, all edges softly fading to transparency with generous separation and empty margins. Dark charcoal blue and muted slate grey, low contrast subtle moonlit edges. One elongated layered bank, one soft low billow, one broken diagonal veil and one spreading wispy bank. Broad painterly shapes and suggested detail, no repetitive tiny cloud puffs or harsh white highlights. Each formation wider than tall. Intended for low-opacity moving overlays in a dark frostbound ruined courtyard. No background sky, no architecture, no figures, no rectangle, no checkerboard, no lettering.
prompts.mist: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent texture atlas: FOUR different thin cold ground mist formations in a 2 by 2 grid, evenly spaced with generous clear transparent margins. True alpha. Pale desaturated blue-grey, translucent, low density, visible holes and gaps. One long thin frost ribbon, one broken trailing veil, one softly curling low plume and one tapered stream suitable also for icy breath. Painterly broad brushwork, no noisy tiny curls. Wisps much wider than tall, feathered transparent edges, no clipping. Intended as independent drifting mist over dark frozen stone, around ankles and a skeletal frost knight's mouth and free hand. No scene or ground, no architecture or characters, no bright aura, no checkerboard or text.

matte.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer with composition and character preservation.
IMAGE 1 is the scene EDIT TARGET. Images 2–5 are the user's references for winter fantasy matte painting. Their role is style, edge control and suggested detail only. Prioritize the broad graphic brushwork of images 2 and 3 and the quiet broad snow and stone masses of image 4. Do not copy people, terrain layouts, labels or signatures.
The user likes the scene layout but explicitly rejects the uniformly sharp, over-detailed AI finish. Repaint the ENVIRONMENT as a convincing hand-painted fantasy matte painting, with strong economy of detail. This must be a noticeable change in painting language, not simply a blur filter over the existing image.
LOCK COMPOSITION: exact same wide 2:1 frame, open uneven courtyard in lower portion, large left Gothic arch, far central-left keep, broken low arcade in mist, dark right wall edge and Grimjaw on far right. Same perspective, rough spatial layout, lighting direction and dark cold palette. Keep every major silhouette and placement.
LOCK CHARACTER DESIGN: Grimjaw must remain the same approved broad giant with gigantic crescent shoulders, swept enclosing helmet and skull looking left, large irregular glacial armour plates, thick arms and legs, ragged central cloth, heavy chains, teal accents, open icy hand and correct forward-down-held flail. No redesign, no narrowed waist or limbs, no new pose, no changed helmet, no mirror of whole character. Preserve him as the focal point; his model geometry is not up for interpretation.
MATTE PAINTING TREATMENT: Simplify walls into big flat dark stone planes and grouped value shapes. Indicate masonry with only a few irregular marks and lost joints, not every brick, bevel or crack. The left arch reads through its overall silhouette and 2–3 selected structural edges, with most interior detail lost in shadow. The distant keep is a soft layered silhouette, barely described through cold haze. Low ruined arches fade into mist instead of being outlined crisply.
The courtyard retains its uneven slabs and changes of level, but each slab is a broad painterly plane, not a photoreal rock texture. Merge tiny cracks, frost flecks and repetitive pebble edges into quiet surfaces. Patchy snow becomes broad broken brush strokes and softly drifting bands, not thousands of white highlights. Selected nearest slab edges get a few decisive sharp strokes; other edges are lost. Keep open dark patches so the floor is useful for raid controls.
Clouds become 3–4 broad atmospheric masses with long sweeping brushwork, soft transitions, no countless finely outlined popcorn puffs. Ground mist is shaped by translucent strokes and the underlying value design, not dense noise.
VISIBLE PAINTING QUALITY: opaque colour blocking, irregular broad brush marks, selective dry brush, simplified planes, varied hard/soft/lost edges, detail clustered deliberately at Grimjaw's face and a handful of near edges. The image should read first as five large light/dark masses at thumbnail size. Suppress microtexture across at least 80 percent of environment. No uniform sharpening, HDR, glossy 3D shading, plastic sheen, synthetic grunge, confetti, excessive ice glitter or uniformly explained detail. Do not merely desaturate or globally Gaussian-blur the old scene.
Only Grimjaw and the empty frozen courtyard. No added people, animals, skeletons, painted falling snow, magic attacks, anchor motifs, lettering, signature, watermark, logo, UI or border. Output the same 2:1 composition as a much more painterly base for separately animated clouds and mist.
